ios.desc:
Galerion,Custom Media Slideshow Viewer

Galerion is not a storage app — it’s a smart viewer for your photos, videos, and audio files. Your media stays on your device or cloud; Galerion simply helps you display and organize it beautifully.

Key Features:

Custom Playlists: Create and manage lists of photos, videos, and audio files.

Slideshow Mode: Play media in slideshow style with shuffle and timer controls.

Flexible Viewing: Set the order and duration for each media file.

Offline Support: Works without internet; shows media stored on your device.

Privacy Friendly: No files are downloaded or stored by the app. Your data stays with you.

Ad & Subscription Options: Use for free with ads, or upgrade for ad-free premium features.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula

show_hn.title: Show HN: Galerion – Minimal app to organize and play your media

quotes.text:
Hi HN!

I built *Galerion* because I was tired of messy galleries and complicated media managers.

With Galerion, you can:
- Organize photos, videos, and audio into playlists
- Play them offline, even without internet
- Share easily, all in a minimal, privacy-friendly app

Important: *Galerion never uploads your files or creates copies*. It simply reads from your device’s gallery. If you delete a file there, it disappears in Galerion too.

It's live on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.berk.galerion) and [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/galerion/id6752312342).

I'd love your feedback on UX, performance, or ideas for new features. Ask me anything!
